description: In relay_queue.rs, move_to_dead_letter() increments the dead_letter_count metric and then attempts the rename. If the rename fails (e.g. cross-device link, permission error) the function returns an error but the counter has already been bumped. The dead_letter_count gauge will drift upward relative to actual dead-letter files, causing the operator to see false dead-letter counts in metrics. Fix: only increment the counter after both renames succeed.
title: smtp: dead-letter count incremented on rename failure
